description:
Your island home is sinking into the ocean, and you're the one to save it!
You'll need to find, train and breed an army of the coolest, weirdest and
cutest Dragon Warrior monsters to ever live inside your Game Boy!

dqm2-v0.0.1.description:
Main Story Playable from start to Darck

## Changelog
- Added docs
- Added tracker support
- Fixed many location names, broken locations, logic errors
- Fixed Darck Goal
(Thanks to OmegaZeron for finding the all of these fixes)

### New Options
**Monster Randomization**
- Randomize Breeding Results

**Encounter Randomization**
- Randomize Encounters (now works!)
- Randomize Encounter Skills 
- Randomize Encounter Stats 

## Known Issues
- Text from NPCs that give you items will probably not match what items you are given.
- The Prisoner in Oasis World doesn't take your meat.
- Mom and Dad lie about giving you items and may cause hallucinations about your monster's stats or appearance.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Whizzlefern/Archipelago/compare/dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha-2...dqm2-v0.0.1
dqm2-v0.0.1.title: DQM2 0.0.1

dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha.description:
### Mostly Untested v0.0.1-alpha
Theoretically playable from start to Darck.
Use at your own risk!

**Changes from vanilla behavior**
Being sent an item with a full inventory will place it in the Vault. 

**Quirks**
- Items from most NPCs/Cut Scenes are not randomized and may give you duplicates, allowing you to break logic.
- World Keys are in their vanilla locations
- Monsters are randomized (no ??? monsters to prevent possible Oasis World softlock)
- No post game content
- The options mostly don't do anything, lol

All of these will be fixed/updated with time...
dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha.title: DQM2 v0.0.1-alpha

dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha-2.description:
Theoretically playable from start to Darck.
Extremely untested.
**Use at your own risk!**

# Changelog
Keys can now properly be received. Still no randomization, but you can !getitem them at least.
Boss monsters are now able to be randomized.
Encounters are now fully randomized, scaling by level.

## New Options
**Monster Randomization**
- Better Join Rate
- Randomize EXP Growth
- Randomize Stat Growths

**Encounter Randomization**
- Allowed Monsters
- Force Four Skills
- EXP Multiplier

# Quirks
- Items from most NPCs/Cut Scenes are not randomized and may give you duplicates, allowing you to break logic.
- World Keys are in their vanilla locations. 
- Monsters are always randomized.
- No post game content, unless you !getitem their keys.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Whizzlefern/Archipelago/compare/dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha...dqm2-v0.0.1-alpha-2

dqm2-v0.1.0.description:
# Changelog
## New Features
- Warp from anywhere from the Plan -> Keys menu.
- Change your sprite in the host.yaml! See the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/Whizzlefern/Archipelago/blob/dqm2/worlds/dqm2/docs/setup_en.md) for more information.
- Many cut scenes have been abridged or outright removed. See below.
  - This does not include GreatLog, those will be in a future QoL Update.
  - Many cut scenes include one line of dialogue, this is to future proof when I update their text to include what items they actually give.
## Cut Scene Changes
### Oasis
- Circus Quest is skipped.
- Canal is open from the start.
- Prisoner can be talked to from the start and no longer requires meat.
- Boss cut scenes abridged.
### Pirate
- Pub Man Quest is skipped.
- Mermaid no longer needs a dance move.
- Cape Cave boss is no longer required to be water and with a dance move.
- Boss, Lighthouse, and Volcano cut scenes abridged.
### Ice
- Imposter King Quest shortened.
- Yuna Boss can be fought without talking to her in the forest first.
- Boss cut scenes abridged.
### Sky
- Sage Tower door no longer cares about your wild.
- Fhunt Gravestone is accessible from the start.
- Mad Condor can be fought without going to Sage Tower first.
- Boss cut scenes abridged.
### Limbo
- Darck cut scenes abridged.
- Credits are skipped.
## Bug Fixes
- (Developer Bug) Yuna no longer requires Pirate Ship to be completed to give her item.
- Fixed Ice: Lake Tower - 5F Left Chest writing its item to the wrong place on the ROM.
- Stopped Mom and Dad from lying about giving you items. Now they just don't try to give you anything!
- Added some missing boss sprite changes.
## Known Issues
- Spirit Spring Boss only requires Estria Castle Boss to be defeated.
- Dam doesn't spawn in the canal (not that it really blocks anything in the first place...)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Whizzlefern/Archipelago/compare/dqm2-v0.0.4...dqm2-v0.1.0
dqm2-v0.1.0.title: DQM2 0.1.0 - QoL Update 1
